---
title: "Build SNP Dominance Relationship Matrix"
---

## Build SNP Dominance Relationship Matrix {.unnumbered}


### Description

Constructs the SNP dominance relationship matrix (D) following
Da et al. (2015). Captures non-additive (dominance) genetic
relationships among individuals. Can be used alongside the additive
G matrix in <code>masreml()</code> to partition genetic variance into
additive and dominance components.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_D_snp(W)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="W">W</code></td>
<td>
numeric matrix (n x m) of raw genotype codes, where n is the
number of individuals and m is the number of SNP markers. Values must
be 0, 1, or 2. Same format as <code>build_G_snp</code>.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

numeric matrix (n x n) of dominance relationships.



### References

Da et al. (2015) Multi-allelic haplotype model based on genetic partition for genomic prediction
and variance component estimation using SNP markers. <em>BMC Genet.</em> 15:100.



### See Also

<code>build_G_snp</code>, <code>masreml</code>



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
library("masreml")

W <- matrix(sample(0:2, 100*50, replace=TRUE), 100, 50)
rownames(W) <- paste0("ind", 1:100)

# Additive + dominance model
fit <- masreml(
  y       = y,
  markers = list(snp_add = W, snp_dom = W)
)
summary(fit)




```
